discovery_notes: Cell B089 lic-other 2022-2023. 30 standard WebSearches, snippets only, blocked domains passed on every query. Main sources: Disney Pins Blog, FiGPiN.com blog, WDWNT/Laughing Place, Toynk/Target listings. FiGPiN pins treated as separately sold single pins (each has own number/run). Hot Topic 2022 leads from Loungefly cell resolved as Loungefly-made; character lists held per rule 12. Amazon Disney100 series keys use uncas- only where a source names Uncas.
